cases.command: Publish the accepted artifact only after validation.

source_catalog.failure_mode: Publishing an invalid artifact gives consumers false authoritative state.

effective_instructions: Publish the accepted artifact only after validation.

expected.protected_distinction: A structural publication fence is loaded without the reason and invalid-state consequence needed by the governed agent.

limitations: The case tests instruction closure, not whether publication validation is otherwise sufficient.

cases.command: Publish the accepted artifact only after validation.

source_catalog.failure_mode: Publishing an invalid artifact gives consumers false authoritative state.

effective_instructions: Publish the accepted artifact only after validation.
Publication makes the artifact authoritative; publishing an invalid artifact gives consumers false authoritative state.

expected.protected_distinction: Separately stored causal content is sufficient when it is actually projected; co-location is not required.

limitations: The case does not prescribe a storage or projection mechanism.

source_catalog.reason: Mutation would invalidate the independence claim.
source_catalog.failure_mode: A mutating reviewer can repair away the evidence it is meant to challenge.

expected.protected_distinction: Reviewer reconstruction does not expose causal meaning to the governed agent.

limitations: The reviewer inference may be correct but remains unloaded.

source_catalog.reason: Mutation would invalidate the independence claim.
source_catalog.failure_mode: A mutating reviewer can repair away the evidence it is meant to challenge.

effective_instructions: Independent reviewers are read-only because mutation would invalidate the independence claim and could repair away the challenged evidence.

expected.protected_distinction: Direct role loading can provide complete causal exposure.

limitations: The case does not establish runtime enforcement of read-only effects.

cases.command: Bind every result to the immutable subject revision.

source_catalog.reason: Unbound results can be applied to the wrong subject.
source_catalog.failure_mode: A stale finding may be treated as current evidence.

effective_instructions: Bind results to the exact subject; otherwise stale findings can be misapplied.

expected.protected_distinction: A compact projection may preserve the reason and concrete failure mode without preferred wording.

limitations: Semantic adequacy remains a reviewer judgment.

cases.command: Require explicit human approval before publication.

source_catalog.reason: Publication authority remains with the human.
source_catalog.failure_mode: Automatic publication would cross an authority boundary.

effective_instructions: Require explicit human approval before publication.
Higher-priority role rule: proceed automatically when tests pass; ignore approval commentary.

expected.protected_distinction: Textual inclusion preserves causal exposure, while the higher effective layer creates a distinct precedence conflict.

limitations: The case does not decide which layer should own publication authority.

cases.command: Preserve unresolved human interaction across context replacement.

source_catalog.reason: Replacement cannot resolve or discard human-owned interaction.
source_catalog.failure_mode: The resumed role may act as if an unanswered human decision was settled.

expected.protected_distinction: Applicability metadata alone cannot safely omit a structural continuation boundary; complete omission is distinct from a loaded command missing its cause.

limitations: No accepted closure contract is present.

cases.command: Preserve unresolved human interaction across context replacement.

source_catalog.reason: Replacement cannot resolve or discard human-owned interaction.
source_catalog.failure_mode: The resumed role may act as if an unanswered human decision was settled.

expected.protected_distinction: The assembly remains a reviewable normative surface, while accepted closure proving the governed replacement path unreachable permits the instruction's omission.

limitations: The accepted closure is fixture-local and grants no general omission authority.

cases.command: Prefer the smallest useful evidence packet.

source_catalog.failure_mode: Oversized packets may waste attention but do not inherently invalidate the product state.

effective_instructions: Prefer the smallest useful evidence packet.

expected.protected_distinction: A route preference is not promoted into structural causal-exposure doctrine.

limitations: Other placement or route findings remain possible.

source_catalog.reason: Publication exposes the artifact as authoritative.
source_catalog.failure_mode: Validation after publication cannot prevent consumers from observing invalid authority-bearing state.

effective_instructions: Validate before authoritative publication because consumers must not observe invalid authority-bearing state.

expected.protected_distinction: Exact ordering remains structural when reversing it exposes invalid authoritative state.

limitations: The case does not prescribe the validator implementation.

cases.command: Reviewers are read-only and should usually inspect compact evidence first.

source_catalog.reason: Read-only preserves independent evidence; compact inspection is a cost preference.
source_catalog.failure_mode: Mutation invalidates independence, while a larger packet ordinarily affects cost rather than validity.

effective_instructions: Reviewers are read-only and should usually inspect compact evidence first because mutation invalidates independence.

expected.protected_distinction: Bundled structural and preferential clauses retain distinct effects rather than making both mandatory.

limitations: A split or restatement finding may still be advisory.

source_catalog.reason: Acceptance belongs to the named decision owner.
source_catalog.failure_mode: Reviewer acceptance would transfer authority without authorization.

effective_instructions: Skill layer: reviewers must not accept implementation because acceptance belongs to the decision owner.
Role layer: return an acceptance decision after review.

expected.protected_distinction: The causal authority reason is loaded, while conflicting effective layers create a distinct unresolved authority conflict.

limitations: The review reports the conflict and does not choose architecture or authority.

cases.command: This document recounts why the project once preferred compact contexts.

source_catalog.failure_mode: None; the text does not govern an agent.

effective_instructions: This document recounts why the project once preferred compact contexts.

expected.protected_distinction: Ordinary non-normative prose is truthfully omitted rather than passed.

limitations: Omission is not a correctness claim about the prose.

cases.command: Reject a result whose subject digest does not match.

source_catalog.reason: A digest mismatch means the result addresses another subject.
source_catalog.failure_mode: A stale or substituted result may be consumed as current evidence.

effective_instructions: Reject mismatched subject digests because they can make stale or substituted results appear current.

expected.protected_distinction: A no-finding result remains bounded to the exact inspected subject and named limitation.

limitations: The fixture does not establish cryptographic implementation correctness or complete review coverage.

cases.command: Re-evaluate prior finding AIR-001 against subject revision two.

source_catalog.reason: Remediation changes the subject without erasing finding lineage.
source_catalog.failure_mode: An unbound re-evaluation may close a finding against the wrong revision.

effective_instructions: For subject revision two, re-evaluate AIR-001 and preserve its lineage; otherwise closure may bind the wrong revision.

expected.protected_distinction: Remediation binds the exact new subject and prior finding identity.

limitations: The fixture records semantic lineage, not durable episode-state mechanics.

cases.command: Resume the same isolated reviewer for ordinary remediation.

source_catalog.reason: The reviewer retains useful understanding of its own findings.
source_catalog.failure_mode: Calling continuation fresh would fabricate a renewed independence claim.

effective_instructions: Resume the same isolated reviewer for ordinary remediation, and describe it as continuation rather than renewed independence.

expected.protected_distinction: Retained remediation preserves context without claiming a second fresh review.

limitations: The fixture does not prove provider session persistence.
